summary: Beamr Imaging Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on May 6, 2026, submitting a press release titled 'Beamr Research Validates Patented CABR Technology as an AI Training Asset.' The press release reports research results showing that video compressed with Beamr's Content-Adaptive Bitrate (CABR) technology improves AI model resilience, reducing depth estimation error on vulnerable road users by 30.7%. No financial terms, transactions, or corporate actions are disclosed—this is a routine operational announcement about product research. The filing is a standard foreign private issuer report, not a special situation. No deal terms or special-situation mechanics are present, and no what-to-watch angle applies.
